band6Sentence: Governments should give more money to primary schools.
band8Sentence: Governments should allocate more funding to primary education.
explanationVi: Collocation Band 8.0 'allocate funding to' trang trọng và chính xác hơn 'give money to'.

band6Sentence: This trend will probably have big effects on everyone in society.
band8Sentence: This trend is likely to have far-reaching implications for society as a whole.
explanationVi: 'have far-reaching implications for' là cụm nâng cấp chuẩn Band 8.0 cho 'have big effects on'.

band6Sentence: The number of visitors went up a lot from 2 million to 5 million in 2010 to 2015.
band8Sentence: The number of visitors rose sharply from 2 million to 5 million between 2010 and 2015.
explanationVi: Kết hợp động từ 'rise' (nội động từ, quá khứ rose) + trạng từ 'sharply' chuẩn mô tả xu hướng Task 1.

band6Sentence: Sales stayed the same at about 400 units until the end.
band8Sentence: Sales remained stable at around 400 units for the rest of the period.
explanationVi: 'remained stable at' là cụm chuẩn mực thay cho 'stayed the same'.

band6Sentence: Unemployment got to the highest point of 12% in 2009 and then went down slowly.
band8Sentence: Unemployment peaked at 12% in 2009 before declining steadily.
explanationVi: Động từ 'peak at + số liệu' ngắn gọn, chính xác hơn 'get to the highest point'.

band6Sentence: The price of solar panels went down very fast.
band8Sentence: There was a dramatic fall in the price of solar panels.
explanationVi: Cấu trúc danh từ hóa 'There was a + adj + noun + in' giúp đa dạng ngữ pháp Task 1.

band6Sentence: The number went up and down between 30% and 40% for ten years.
band8Sentence: The figure fluctuated between 30% and 40% throughout the decade.
explanationVi: 'fluctuate between X and Y' diễn tả sự dao động chính xác thay cho 'go up and down'.

band6Sentence: Car ownership went down to the lowest number of 15% in 1990.
band8Sentence: Car ownership reached a low of 15% in 1990.
explanationVi: 'reach a low of + số liệu' là collocation chuẩn cho điểm đáy biểu đồ.

band6Sentence: The number was 45% in the year 2000.
band8Sentence: The figure stood at 45% in 2000.
explanationVi: 'stand at' là động từ học thuật tự nhiên để nêu mốc số liệu khởi điểm thay vì lặp 'was'.

band6Sentence: Exports became more than two times bigger during the chart time.
band8Sentence: Exports more than doubled over the period shown.
explanationVi: Động từ 'double' kèm trạng ngữ 'more than' giúp diễn đạt bội số cực kỳ súc tích.

band6Sentence: The recycled waste became almost three times more from 2000 to 2020.
band8Sentence: The amount of waste recycled nearly tripled between 2000 and 2020.
explanationVi: 'nearly tripled' súc tích hơn rất nhiều so với 'became almost three times more'.

band6Sentence: The percentage of households with internet rose steadily. It reached 90% in 2020.
band8Sentence: The percentage of households with internet access rose steadily, reaching 90% in 2020.
explanationVi: Dùng mệnh đề phân từ V-ing (', reaching ...') để gộp hai câu đơn thành câu phức mượt mà.

band6Sentence: The two lines met at the same point in 2015 at 60%.
band8Sentence: The two lines converged in 2015, when both stood at 60%.
explanationVi: 'converge' là từ chuyên dụng Band 8.0 chỉ hai đường biểu đồ tiến về cùng một điểm.

band6Sentence: Electricity use will probably go up to 300 units in 2030.
band8Sentence: Electricity consumption is projected to rise to 300 units by 2030.
explanationVi: Khi biểu đồ có mốc tương lai, dùng 'is projected/forecast to + V' thay cho 'will probably'.

band6Sentence: In general, coal was always the biggest source and renewables grew the most quickly.
band8Sentence: Overall, it is clear that coal remained the main source of electricity, while renewables grew the fastest.
explanationVi: Mở đoạn Overview bằng 'Overall, it is clear that...' giúp nổi bật xu hướng chính cho tiêu chí Task Achievement.

band6Sentence: In the chart time, the biggest thing to notice is online sales grew fast.
band8Sentence: Over the period shown, the most striking feature is the rapid growth of online sales.
explanationVi: 'the most striking feature is...' là cấu trúc mở Overview tự nhiên, giàu sắc thái học thuật.

band6Sentence: But on the other side, the percentage of older workers dropped a little.
band8Sentence: By contrast, the proportion of older workers fell slightly.
explanationVi: 'By contrast,' (hoặc 'In contrast,') là từ nối đối lập chuẩn xác ở đầu câu.

band6Sentence: Meat eating went down, and vegetable eating went up.
band8Sentence: Meat consumption fell, whereas vegetable consumption increased.
explanationVi: Liên từ 'whereas' nối hai mệnh đề đối lập trong cùng một câu phức chuẩn ngữ pháp.

band6Sentence: Healthcare spending was two times bigger than education spending.
band8Sentence: Spending on healthcare was twice as high as spending on education.
explanationVi: Cấu trúc so sánh bội số chuẩn: 'twice / three times as + adj + as'.

band6Sentence: The number for men was a bit higher than the number for women.
band8Sentence: The figure for men was slightly higher than that for women.
distractors: a little taller than those for
slightly more high than it for
explanationVi: Dùng đại từ thay thế 'that for' (số ít) tránh lặp từ 'the figure for'.

band6Sentence: Compared to 1990, much less people smoked in 2020.
band8Sentence: In comparison with 1990, far fewer people smoked in 2020.
explanationVi: 'In comparison with + N' kết hợp 'far fewer + danh từ đếm được số nhiều' cực chuẩn ngữ pháp.

band6Sentence: Canada also has almost the same kind of chart.
band8Sentence: A similar pattern can be seen in the data for Canada.
explanationVi: 'A similar pattern can be seen in...' dùng để nhóm đối tượng có xu hướng tương đồng.

band6Sentence: Japan had the biggest percent of old people, which was 28%.
band8Sentence: Japan recorded the highest proportion of elderly people, at 28%.
explanationVi: Động từ 'record' + giới từ 'at + số liệu' là bộ đôi nâng cấp điển hình trong Task 1.

band6Sentence: About 24% of people in the survey liked online classes more.
band8Sentence: Approximately a quarter of respondents (24%) preferred online classes.
explanationVi: Quy đổi tỷ lệ phần trăm (~24-26%) sang phân số 'approximately a quarter of' giúp đa dạng từ vựng.

band6Sentence: Almost all students (87%) used a laptop.
band8Sentence: The vast majority of students (87%) used a laptop.
explanationVi: 'The vast majority of' diễn tả tỷ lệ áp đảo (trên 80%) cực kỳ học thuật.

band6Sentence: First, workers collect and sort the raw materials.
band8Sentence: In the first stage of the process, raw materials are collected and sorted.
targetChunk: In the first stage of the process,
distractors: At the starting step in process,
In step number one of making,
explanationVi: Bài Process nên dùng bị động hiện tại đơn kèm cụm đánh dấu giai đoạn 'In the first stage of the process,'.

band6Sentence: After people shape the clay, they put it into a hot oven.
band8Sentence: Once the clay has been shaped, it is fired in a kiln.
targetChunk: Once the clay has been shaped,
explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'Once + S + has/have been + V3' thể hiện sự hoàn tất của bước trước trong bài Process.

band6Sentence: The last step is workers put the product in boxes to send out.
band8Sentence: The final stage involves packaging the product for delivery.
explanationVi: 'involve + V-ing' giúp mô tả giai đoạn quy trình gọn gàng và chuẩn học thuật.

band6Sentence: In the north of the village, they built a new group of houses.
band8Sentence: To the north of the village, a new housing estate was constructed.
explanationVi: 'To the north of' dùng cho vị trí nằm bên ngoài ranh giới; kết hợp bị động quá khứ 'was constructed'.

band6Sentence: They took away the park and built a car park there.
band8Sentence: The park was replaced by a car park.
explanationVi: 'be replaced by' là cấu trúc bị động ngắn gọn chuẩn mực cho bài mô tả bản đồ.

band6Sentence: The old school was changed to become a library.
band8Sentence: The old school was converted into a library.
explanationVi: 'be converted into' dùng chính xác khi giữ khung công trình cũ nhưng đổi công năng.

band6Sentence: The road was made longer so it joined the town and the big highway.
band8Sentence: The road was extended to connect the town with the motorway.
explanationVi: Động từ 'extend' chuyên dùng cho đường sá, cầu cống, bến cảng được kéo dài trên bản đồ.

band6Sentence: Technology has many benefits, but it can also make people lonely.
band8Sentence: Although technology has many benefits, it can also isolate people.
explanationVi: Dùng 'Although + mệnh đề' (không đi kèm 'but') để tạo câu phức nhượng bộ mạch lạc.

band6Sentence: Some people say university should be free, and other people say students should pay.
band8Sentence: While some argue that tuition should be free, others believe students should contribute.
explanationVi: Mở bài dạng Discussion cực gọn và cân bằng bằng cấu trúc 'While some argue that..., others believe...'.

band6Sentence: Cars are convenient, but also cars make air pollution.
band8Sentence: On the one hand, cars offer convenience; on the other hand, they cause pollution.
explanationVi: Cặp liên kết 'On the one hand... on the other hand' chuẩn mực khi phân tích hai mặt vấn đề.

band6Sentence: I know that renewable energy costs a lot of money to set up.
band8Sentence: Admittedly, renewable energy can be expensive to install.
explanationVi: Trạng từ 'Admittedly,' mở câu nhượng bộ sắc sảo trước khi đưa lập luận phản biện.

band6Sentence: But even so, saving money over a long time is very big.
band8Sentence: Nevertheless, the long-term savings are considerable.
explanationVi: 'Nevertheless,' là trạng từ liên kết đầu câu cực ăn khớp ngay sau câu nhượng bộ 'Admittedly,'.

band6Sentence: I am not saying that old-style teaching is useless.
band8Sentence: This is not to say that traditional teaching has no value.
targetChunk: This is not to say that
explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'This is not to say that...' làm mềm lập luận, tránh cực đoan — đặc trưng văn phong Band 8.0.

band6Sentence: Different from what many people think, older workers often work better.
band8Sentence: Contrary to popular belief, older workers are often more productive.
explanationVi: 'Contrary to + cụm danh từ' là cụm chuyển ý phản bác quan niệm phổ biến rất tự nhiên.

band6Sentence: This policy might reduce traffic. So the air will get cleaner.
band8Sentence: This policy could reduce traffic. Consequently, air quality would improve.
explanationVi: Dùng 'Consequently,' ở đầu câu thay cho 'So' để giữ văn phong trang trọng.

band6Sentence: Because rents are going up, many young people still stay with their parents.
band8Sentence: Due to rising rents, many young people still live with their parents.
explanationVi: 'Due to + cụm danh từ' giúp câu súc tích hơn mệnh đề 'Because...'.

band6Sentence: Because of machines doing work, lots of factory jobs are gone.
band8Sentence: As a result of automation, many factory jobs have disappeared.
explanationVi: 'As a result of + N' diễn đạt nguyên nhân khách quan, rất hợp chủ đề công nghệ và kinh tế.

band6Sentence: Workers feel more motivated. And then this makes productivity higher.
band8Sentence: Workers become more motivated. This, in turn, leads to higher productivity.
explanationVi: Chuỗi nhân quả 'This, in turn, leads to...' cho thấy mạch phát triển ý sâu sắc (Coherence & Cohesion 8.0).

band6Sentence: Exercise improves health, and also it can make people work better.
band8Sentence: In addition to improving health, exercise can boost productivity.
explanationVi: 'In addition to + V-ing/N' gọn gàng hơn việc nối bằng 'and also'.

band6Sentence: Tourism creates jobs and it also helps cultural exchange.
band8Sentence: Not only does tourism create jobs, but it also promotes cultural exchange.
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ 'Not only + trợ động từ + S + V' nâng điểm Grammatical Range rõ rệt.

band6Sentence: If governments put more money into buses and trains, fewer people would drive.
band8Sentence: Were governments to invest more in public transport, fewer people would drive.
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 2 'Were + S + to V' là cấu trúc giả định Band 8.0 kinh điển.

band6Sentence: If they had started the policy sooner, many people would not have died.
band8Sentence: Had the policy been introduced earlier, many lives could have been saved.
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3 kết hợp bị động 'Had + S + been + V3' cho thấy kiểm soát ngữ pháp đỉnh cao.

band6Sentence: The thing that worries me most is how it affects children's mental health.
band8Sentence: What concerns me most is the impact on children's mental health.
distractors: What is concerning me most are
explanationVi: Câu chẻ (Wh-cleft sentence) 'What concerns me most is...' giúp nhấn mạnh trọng tâm lập luận.

band6Sentence: How much technology makes learning better depends on how people use it.
band8Sentence: The extent to which technology improves learning depends on how it is used.
explanationVi: Cụm danh từ hóa 'The extent to which...' là dấu ấn học thuật chuẩn Cambridge Band 8.0.

band6Sentence: Instead of making more roads, cities should make public transport better.
band8Sentence: Rather than building more roads, cities should improve public transport.
explanationVi: 'Rather than + V-ing' ở đầu câu nêu sự đối chiếu giải pháp cực sắc bén.

band6Sentence: If people control it well, gene editing might cure many illnesses.
band8Sentence: Provided that it is properly regulated, gene editing could cure many diseases.
targetChunk: Provided that it is properly regulated,
distractors: Only if it is proper regulate,
explanationVi: 'Provided that + mệnh đề' diễn tả điều kiện chặt chẽ thay cho 'If' lặp lại.

band6Sentence: Many people say that university should not cost money.
band8Sentence: It is often argued that university education should be free.
explanationVi: Bị động khách quan 'It is often argued that...' mở đầu vấn đề học thuật trung lập.

band6Sentence: Social media is definitely worse than it is good.
band8Sentence: It could be argued that social media does more harm than good.
explanationVi: Ngôn ngữ rào đón (hedging) 'It could be argued that...' tránh khẳng định cực đoan.

band6Sentence: All young people spend more time on the internet than old people.
band8Sentence: Young people tend to spend more time online than older generations.
explanationVi: Động từ 'tend to + V' là công cụ rào đón đơn giản mà hiệu quả cao nhất trong Task 2.

band6Sentence: In my thinking, the good points are bigger than the bad points.
band8Sentence: From my perspective, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
explanationVi: 'From my perspective,' tự nhiên và tránh lỗi giới từ 'According to me'.

band6Sentence: Online learning has more good things than bad things.
band8Sentence: The advantages of online learning outweigh its drawbacks.
explanationVi: Collocation 'outweigh its drawbacks' là cụm vàng cho dạng đề Advantages/Disadvantages.

band6Sentence: One good example is Singapore because buses and trains there are cheap and good.
band8Sentence: A case in point is Singapore, where public transport is cheap and efficient.
explanationVi: 'A case in point is + N' là cách đưa ví dụ điển hình tinh tế thay vì lặp 'For example'.

band6Sentence: Like many Scandinavian countries give free university.
band8Sentence: For instance, many Scandinavian countries offer free university education.
explanationVi: 'For instance,' dùng chuẩn xác ở đầu câu thay cho 'Like' (vốn quá suồng sã).

band6Sentence: Because of these problems, governments need to do something fast.
band8Sentence: In light of these problems, governments must act quickly.
explanationVi: 'In light of + N' (xét trước tình hình này) là cụm chuyển đoạn kết luận cực mượt.

band6Sentence: Finally, both sides are kind of right, but I think education is most important.
band8Sentence: In conclusion, while both views have merit, I believe education is the key.
explanationVi: 'while both views have merit' tóm tắt sắc thái cân bằng trước khi chốt quan điểm cá nhân.

band6Sentence: After looking at everything, putting money in schools is the best way to stop poverty.
band8Sentence: All things considered, investing in education is the best long-term solution to poverty.
explanationVi: 'All things considered,' là cụm mở đoạn kết luận tự nhiên và sang trọng.

band6Sentence: The main reason is because people move to cities to get better jobs.
band8Sentence: The main reason why people move to cities is to find better jobs.
explanationVi: Tránh lỗi kinh điển 'The reason is because'; dùng 'The main reason why... is to V / that...'.

band6Sentence: Smartphone sales grew very fast between 2012 and 2018.
band8Sentence: Smartphone sales experienced rapid growth between 2012 and 2018.
explanationVi: Danh từ hóa bằng 'experience + adj + noun' giúp đa dạng cấu trúc câu Task 1.

band6Sentence: Coal usage dropped a lot after 2005.
band8Sentence: Coal usage witnessed a steep decline after 2005.
explanationVi: 'witness a steep decline' là collocation cực mượt khi miêu tả đường đi xuống mạnh.

band6Sentence: Tourism numbers went up slowly over the next ten years.
band8Sentence: Tourism numbers climbed steadily over the subsequent decade.
explanationVi: 'climb steadily' + 'the subsequent decade' nâng cấp cả động từ lẫn cụm chỉ thời gian.

band6Sentence: Oil prices dropped suddenly in 2020 and then went back up quickly.
band8Sentence: Oil prices plummeted in 2020 before rebounding sharply.
explanationVi: 'plummet' + 'before rebounding sharply' diễn tả biểu đồ hình chữ V cực đắt giá.

band6Sentence: After 2010, the birth rate stopped changing and stayed flat.
band8Sentence: After 2010, the birth rate plateaued at roughly 1.6 children per woman.
explanationVi: Động từ 'plateau at' chuyên dùng khi đường biểu đồ đi ngang sau giai đoạn tăng/giảm.

band6Sentence: The number of rail passengers dropped a little and then stayed the same.
band8Sentence: Rail passenger numbers dipped slightly before levelling off.
explanationVi: 'dip slightly' + 'levelling off' diễn tả cú giảm nhẹ rồi chững lại chuẩn xác.

band6Sentence: Wind power went up very quickly from 5% to 35%.
band8Sentence: Wind power surged sevenfold from 5% to 35%.
explanationVi: Trạng từ bội số 'sevenfold' (gấp 7 lần) rất súc tích cho mô tả tỷ lệ.

band6Sentence: Internet subscriptions got much bigger than landline phones in 2008.
band8Sentence: Internet subscriptions overtook landline connections in 2008.
explanationVi: Động từ 'overtake' (quá khứ overtook) chuyên dùng khi một đường vượt lên trên đường khác.

band6Sentence: The gap between rich and poor regions got bigger every year.
band8Sentence: The disparity between urban and rural incomes widened progressively.
explanationVi: 'disparity' + 'widen progressively' nâng cấp hoàn toàn cho 'gap got bigger'.

band6Sentence: The difference between men and women got smaller by 2020.
band8Sentence: The gender gap narrowed considerably by 2020.
explanationVi: 'narrow considerably' là collocation tự nhiên của 'gap'.

band6Sentence: Gas consumption fell by half during the twenty-year period.
band8Sentence: Gas consumption halved over the twenty-year timeframe.
explanationVi: Động từ 'halve' (giảm một nửa) gọn hơn nhiều so với 'fell by half'.

band6Sentence: Coffee exports rose a little bit from 100 to 108 tonnes.
band8Sentence: Coffee exports edged upward marginally from 100 to 108 tonnes.
explanationVi: 'edge upward marginally' mô tả mức tăng rất nhẹ cực kỳ tinh tế.

band6Sentence: Attendance went up and down wildly throughout the winter.
band8Sentence: Attendance exhibited erratic fluctuations throughout the winter.
explanationVi: 'exhibit erratic fluctuations' dùng cho đường zic-zac biến động thất thường.

band6Sentence: By 2018, bicycle use had gone back to its 2000 level.
band8Sentence: By 2018, bicycle usage had returned to its original 2000 baseline.
explanationVi: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành 'By + năm, S + had returned to...' tăng điểm ngữ pháp mạnh.

band6Sentence: Solar output will probably reach 50% by 2040.
band8Sentence: Solar output is anticipated to account for 50% of supply by 2040.
explanationVi: 'be anticipated to account for' chuẩn mực cho dự báo tỷ trọng tương lai.

band6Sentence: Housing took up 42% of the average household budget.
band8Sentence: Housing accounted for 42% of average household expenditure.
explanationVi: 'account for' là động từ hàng đầu thay cho 'take up' trong biểu đồ tròn (Pie chart).

band6Sentence: Transport made up just under a fifth of total spending.
band8Sentence: Transport constituted just under a fifth of total outlay.
explanationVi: 'constitute' + phân số 'just under a fifth' (18–19%) giúp bài Pie chart giàu từ vựng.

band6Sentence: Only a very small part (3%) came from nuclear power.
band8Sentence: Nuclear power represented a negligible share, at merely 3%.
explanationVi: 'represent a negligible share' nâng cấp câu mô tả phần tỷ trọng nhỏ nhất.

band6Sentence: Food and rent together were more than half of all costs.
band8Sentence: Combined, food and rent comprised well over half of total expenditure.
explanationVi: 'Combined, ... comprised well over half' gộp hạng mục thông minh.

band6Sentence: Almost two out of three residents used buses daily.
band8Sentence: Roughly two-thirds of residents relied on bus services daily.
explanationVi: Phân số 'two-thirds' nhớ có 's' ở mẫu số khi tử số lớn hơn 1.

band6Sentence: Exactly half of the respondents were aged under thirty.
band8Sentence: Precisely half of those surveyed fell into the under-thirty bracket.
explanationVi: Cụm 'fall into the ... bracket' chuyên dùng để mô tả nhóm tuổi hoặc nhóm thu nhập.

band6Sentence: France produced much more wine than Germany did.
band8Sentence: France outstripped Germany by a wide margin in wine production.
targetChunk: outstripped Germany by a wide margin
explanationVi: 'outstrip X by a wide margin' là cách so sánh vượt trội chuẩn Band 8.0.

band6Sentence: Italy was the second biggest exporter after Spain.
band8Sentence: Italy ranked second behind Spain in total export volume.
explanationVi: 'rank second behind X' diễn tả thứ hạng rõ ràng, không rườm rà.

band6Sentence: The figures for Japan and South Korea were almost the same.
band8Sentence: The figures for Japan and South Korea were virtually identical.
explanationVi: 'virtually identical' thay thế gọn gàng cho 'almost the same'.

band6Sentence: Men spent three times more hours playing games than women.
band8Sentence: Men devoted three times as many hours to gaming as their female counterparts.
explanationVi: 'female/male counterparts' tránh lặp từ 'men/women' rất hiệu quả.

band6Sentence: Younger shoppers bought far more clothes online than older ones.
band8Sentence: Online apparel purchases were markedly higher among younger cohorts than older demographics.
explanationVi: 'markedly higher' + 'cohorts / demographics' mang sắc thái học thuật rõ rệt.

band6Sentence: While Germany spent the most, Portugal spent the least.
band8Sentence: Germany led overall expenditure, whereas Portugal trailed at the bottom of the table.
explanationVi: 'lead ... whereas X trailed at the bottom' tạo độ tương phản sắc nét.

band6Sentence: Water use in agriculture was far bigger than in industry.
band8Sentence: Agricultural water consumption dwarfed that of the industrial sector.
explanationVi: Động từ 'dwarf' (làm lu mờ vì lớn gấp nhiều lần) rất ấn tượng khi chênh lệch cực lớn.

band6Sentence: Both countries showed rising literacy, although Kenya grew faster.
band8Sentence: Both nations recorded gains in literacy, albeit at a markedly brisker pace in Kenya.
targetChunk: albeit at a markedly brisker pace
explanationVi: Liên từ 'albeit + cụm giới từ' giúp rút gọn mệnh đề nhượng bộ tinh tế.

band6Sentence: London had 9 million people, compared with 3 million in Madrid.
band8Sentence: London's population stood at 9 million, threefold that of Madrid.
explanationVi: 'threefold that of' rút gọn vế so sánh bội số cực kỳ súc tích.

band6Sentence: Overall, all three countries used more clean energy over time.
band8Sentence: Overall, an upward trajectory was evident across all three nations throughout the timeframe.
explanationVi: 'an upward trajectory was evident' nâng tầm câu Overview hẳn một band.

band6Sentence: In general, the village became much more modern and lost its farms.
band8Sentence: Overall, the village underwent substantial modernisation at the expense of its agricultural land.
explanationVi: 'undergo modernisation at the expense of...' là khung Overview hoàn hảo cho bài Map.

band6Sentence: Overall, making paper takes seven steps from cutting trees to rolling paper.
band8Sentence: Overall, the linear manufacturing process comprises seven distinct stages, culminating in paper reels.
targetChunk: comprises seven distinct stages, culminating in
distractors: has seven different steps, ending at
explanationVi: 'comprise X distinct stages, culminating in...' là câu Overview chuẩn cho bài Process.

band6Sentence: In short, older people preferred TV while young people liked phones.
band8Sentence: Overall, clear generational divergence emerged, with older adults favouring television and younger groups preferring smartphones.
explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'with + N + V-ing' kèm 'generational divergence' rất tự nhiên.

band6Sentence: Next, the beans are washed and put in the sun to dry.
band8Sentence: Subsequently, the harvested beans are rinsed thoroughly before being sun-dried.
explanationVi: Bị động sau giới từ 'before being + V3' giúp giữ mạch bị động nhất quán.

band6Sentence: Then the hot glass is shaped into bottles by a machine.
band8Sentence: Following this, the molten glass is moulded into bottles via an automated press.
explanationVi: 'molten glass' + 'be moulded into' thể hiện vốn từ chuyên biệt cao.

band6Sentence: After that, the water goes through a filter to become clean.
band8Sentence: Thereafter, the water passes through a filtration unit to remove impurities.
explanationVi: 'filtration unit' + 'remove impurities' chuẩn văn phong kỹ thuật Task 1 Process.

band6Sentence: Finally, the bottles are checked and sent to shops.
band8Sentence: In the culminating step, finished bottles undergo quality inspection prior to retail distribution.
explanationVi: 'undergo quality inspection prior to...' chuyên nghiệp hơn hẳn 'are checked and sent'.

band6Sentence: The cycle starts again when adult salmon swim back upstream.
band8Sentence: The reproductive cycle repeats once mature salmon migrate back upstream.
explanationVi: Dùng cho biểu đồ vòng đời tự nhiên (natural cycle): 'reproductive cycle', 'mature', 'migrate'.

band6Sentence: The farmland on the west side was destroyed to build a shopping mall.
band8Sentence: Farmland along the western flank was cleared to make way for a retail complex.
targetChunk: was cleared to make way for
distractors: was broken to give place to
explanationVi: 'be cleared to make way for' là collocation kinh điển cho bài Map.

band6Sentence: A new bridge was built across the river next to the old factory.
band8Sentence: A pedestrian bridge was erected across the river adjacent to the former factory.
targetChunk: was erected across the river adjacent to
distractors: was stood over the river beside
explanationVi: 'be erected' + 'adjacent to' nâng cấp đồng thời động từ và giới từ vị trí.

band6Sentence: The small harbour became much bigger to hold cruise ships.
band8Sentence: The modest harbour underwent considerable expansion to accommodate cruise liners.
explanationVi: 'undergo considerable expansion to accommodate...' diễn tả sự mở rộng cơ sở hạ tầng.

band6Sentence: The railway station stayed in the same place the whole time.
band8Sentence: The railway station remained unchanged throughout the entire twenty-year period.
explanationVi: Bài Map luôn cần nêu ít nhất 1 chi tiết giữ nguyên bằng 'remained unchanged / intact'.

band6Sentence: Trees were planted all around the edge of the sports centre.
band8Sentence: The perimeter of the sports complex was lined with newly planted trees.
explanationVi: 'perimeter ... was lined with' miêu tả hàng cây bao quanh rất chuẩn xác.

band6Sentence: Sales rose to $5m in 2015, and this was the highest point.
band8Sentence: Sales rose to $5 million in 2015, marking the highest point of the decade.
explanationVi: Mệnh đề rút gọn ', marking...' nối số liệu và nhận xét trong một câu duy nhất.

band6Sentence: Nowadays many people think cities are too crowded.
band8Sentence: In contemporary society, rapid urban overcrowding has emerged as a pressing concern.
targetChunk: has emerged as a pressing concern
distractors: has come out as big worry
explanationVi: Tránh câu mở đầu sáo rỗng 'Nowadays many people think...'; dùng 'has emerged as a pressing concern'.

band6Sentence: Some people say zoos are bad, while others say they save animals.
band8Sentence: Opinion remains sharply divided over whether zoological parks exploit wildlife or safeguard endangered species.
targetChunk: Opinion remains sharply divided over whether
distractors: Ideas stay very split about if
explanationVi: Câu mở đề Discussion Band 8.0 gọn, khách quan và bao quát hai luồng ý kiến.

band6Sentence: I completely agree with the idea that governments should tax sugary drinks.
band8Sentence: I wholeheartedly endorse the proposal to levy higher taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages.
targetChunk: wholeheartedly endorse the proposal to levy
distractors: fully say yes to plan putting
explanationVi: 'endorse the proposal to levy taxes on' nâng tầm Lexical Resource cực mạnh.

band6Sentence: Working from home always makes employees happier.
band8Sentence: Remote work often fosters greater job satisfaction, provided that clear boundaries are maintained.
explanationVi: Tránh 'always'; dùng 'often fosters' kèm điều kiện 'provided that'.

band6Sentence: Social media destroys teenagers' mental health completely.
band8Sentence: Excessive social media exposure can exert a detrimental influence on adolescent psychological wellbeing.
explanationVi: 'exert a detrimental influence on' vừa học thuật vừa có độ rào đón ('can').

band6Sentence: Banning cars in city centres will solve air pollution.
band8Sentence: Restricting private vehicles in inner cities would go a long way towards curbing urban air pollution.
targetChunk: would go a long way towards curbing
distractors: would go far way for cut
explanationVi: 'go a long way towards + V-ing' diễn tả giải pháp mang lại hiệu quả lớn mà không nói quá.

band6Sentence: University degrees are useless now because of online courses.
band8Sentence: While online courses widen access, formal degrees arguably retain substantial signalling value for employers.
explanationVi: Trạng từ rào đón 'arguably' thể hiện tư duy phản biện sắc sảo.

band6Sentence: Too much homework makes students stressed and tired.
band8Sentence: An excessive academic workload can precipitate chronic stress and emotional burnout among pupils.
explanationVi: Động từ 'precipitate' (châm ngòi, gây ra nhanh chóng) rất đắt giá trong bài nguyên nhân-hệ quả.

band6Sentence: Bad public transport causes more traffic jams.
band8Sentence: Inadequate public transit infrastructure inevitably drives commuters toward private car dependency.
explanationVi: 'drive X toward Y' mô tả cơ chế nhân quả hành vi rất tự nhiên.

band6Sentence: Poor diets lead to higher hospital costs for the country.
band8Sentence: Widespread nutritional deficiencies place an unsustainable strain on national healthcare budgets.
explanationVi: 'place an unsustainable strain on' là collocation Band 8.0 chuẩn cho áp lực ngân sách.

band6Sentence: Cutting down forests makes climate change worse.
band8Sentence: Unchecked deforestation accelerates greenhouse emissions, thereby compounding global climate instability.
explanationVi: ', thereby + V-ing' nối kết quả tức thì trong cùng một câu cực mượt.

band6Sentence: This problem happens because people lack financial education.
band8Sentence: This predicament stems primarily from a widespread lack of early financial literacy.
explanationVi: 'stem primarily from' là động từ học thuật thay cho 'happen because of'.

band6Sentence: Better childcare lets more mothers return to work.
band8Sentence: Accessible childcare enables parents to re-enter the labour market, fostering broader economic growth.
explanationVi: Mệnh đề phân từ ', fostering...' nối chuỗi hệ quả tự nhiên.

band6Sentence: Even though electric cars are expensive, they save fuel over time.
band8Sentence: Notwithstanding their steep upfront cost, electric vehicles deliver lower lifetime operating expenses.
distractors: Despite of their high first price,
In spite they cost high first,
explanationVi: 'Notwithstanding + cụm danh từ' là dạng nhượng bộ trang trọng bậc cao.

band6Sentence: Even if governments pass strict laws, some companies will still pollute.
band8Sentence: Strict legislation alone, however well-intentioned, cannot eliminate corporate pollution without rigorous enforcement.
explanationVi: Cấu trúc chêm ', however + adj,' tạo câu văn mạch lạc, sắc sảo.

band6Sentence: Yes, tourism brings money, but it also damages old buildings.
band8Sentence: Granted, mass tourism generates vital revenue; yet unchecked visitor numbers can erode fragile heritage sites.
explanationVi: 'Granted, ...; yet ...' là cặp nhượng bộ – phản biện ngắn gọn, đầy uy lực.

band6Sentence: Although AI helps doctors, it cannot replace human empathy.
band8Sentence: Valuable though AI diagnostics may be, algorithms cannot replicate genuine human empathy.
targetChunk: Valuable though AI diagnostics may be,
explanationVi: Đảo tính từ lên đầu 'Adj + though/as + S + may be' là cấu trúc Band 8.5 ấn tượng.

band6Sentence: Unlike rich nations, developing countries struggle to fund green energy.
band8Sentence: In stark contrast to affluent nations, developing economies face acute capital constraints in financing clean energy.
explanationVi: 'In stark contrast to' tạo sắc thái đối lập mạnh và chuẩn collocation.

band6Sentence: Some workers love flexibility, while others feel lonely at home.
band8Sentence: Whereas remote arrangements appeal to self-directed staff, they can leave newer employees feeling isolated.
explanationVi: 'Whereas' mở đầu câu so sánh hai nhóm đối tượng mạch lạc.

band6Sentence: We rarely see such rapid change in job markets.
band8Sentence: Seldom have labour markets undergone such rapid structural transformation.
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ trạng từ phủ định 'Seldom + have + S + V3' giúp nâng tầm ngữ pháp.

band6Sentence: Society can solve this crisis only by working together.
band8Sentence: Only through coordinated international cooperation can nations tackle transboundary climate risks.
targetChunk: Only through coordinated international cooperation can
distractors: Only by global working together nations can
Only through cooperation nations are able
Only when cooperating can nations to
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ 'Only through + N + modal + S + V' cực hợp đoạn giải pháp/kết luận.

band6Sentence: We should never sacrifice student safety for lower costs.
band8Sentence: Under no circumstances should schools compromise student safety to cut expenditure.
targetChunk: Under no circumstances should schools compromise
distractors: In no situation schools should give up
Under no condition should schools to risk
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ 'Under no circumstances + should + S + V' mang sắc thái khẳng định đanh thép.

band6Sentence: If cities fail to upgrade drainage, floods will worsen.
band8Sentence: Should municipalities fail to modernise drainage networks, seasonal flooding will intensify.
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1 'Should + S + V' trang trọng hơn 'If...'.

band6Sentence: It is very important that governments protect wetlands.
band8Sentence: It is imperative that policymakers safeguard remaining coastal wetlands before irreversible loss occurs.
targetChunk: It is imperative that policymakers safeguard
distractors: It is urgent for policymakers safeguarding
It is imperative policymakers to protect
It is very vital that officials protects
explanationVi: Thức giả định 'It is imperative that + S + V (nguyên thể)' chuẩn Band 8.0.

band6Sentence: When people live longer, pension systems face more pressure.
band8Sentence: The longer life expectancy rises, the heavier the fiscal burden placed on state pension funds.
targetChunk: The longer life expectancy rises, the heavier
distractors: More long people live, more heavy
The more longer life grows, heavier
As longer life expectancy, the heavier
explanationVi: Cấu trúc so sánh kép 'The + adj-er ..., the + adj-er ...' diễn tả mối tương quan tuyến tính.

band6Sentence: Because they lack affordable homes, young couples delay having kids.
band8Sentence: Constrained by soaring housing prices, many young couples postpone starting a family.
explanationVi: Mệnh đề phân từ quá khứ 'Constrained by...' rút gọn nguyên nhân cực gọn.

band6Sentence: People should focus on preventing disease instead of just treating it.
band8Sentence: Health systems ought to prioritise preventive care over costly late-stage intervention.
explanationVi: 'prioritise A over B' diễn tả thứ tự ưu tiên chính sách cực súc tích.

band6Sentence: The internet has completely changed how news is shared.
band8Sentence: Digital platforms have fundamentally reshaped the dissemination of public information.
distractors: deeply turned the giving out of
explanationVi: Danh từ hóa 'the dissemination of public information' mang sắc thái học thuật rõ nét.

band6Sentence: Governments need to make strict rules on plastic packaging.
band8Sentence: Authorities must enact stringent regulations governing single-use plastic packaging.
explanationVi: 'enact stringent regulations' là bộ ba collocation chuẩn mực cho chủ đề môi trường/luật.

band6Sentence: Education plays a very big role in reducing crime.
band8Sentence: Equitable access to quality education plays a pivotal role in curbing youth offending.
targetChunk: plays a pivotal role in curbing
distractors: takes a big part to stop
makes a crucial job in cutting
plays a giant role for reducing
explanationVi: 'play a pivotal role in + V-ing' thay thế xuất sắc cho 'play a very big role'.

band6Sentence: We must find a balance between growth and nature.
band8Sentence: Policymakers must strike a delicate balance between economic expansion and ecological preservation.
explanationVi: 'strike a delicate balance between A and B' là cụm tủ Band 8.0 cho mọi đề cân bằng lợi ích.

band6Sentence: Rich countries should help poor countries fight climate change.
band8Sentence: Affluent nations bear a moral obligation to assist developing countries in climate adaptation.
targetChunk: bear a moral obligation to assist
distractors: hold a good duty for helping
carry an ethical must to help
explanationVi: 'bear a moral obligation to + V' nâng cấp mạnh cho 'should help'.

band6Sentence: Advertising makes children want unhealthy snacks.
band8Sentence: Targeted marketing fuels excessive consumption of calorie-dense snacks among children.
explanationVi: Động từ 'fuel' (thúc đẩy mạnh xu hướng tiêu cực) + 'excessive consumption' cực tự nhiên.

band6Sentence: Technology can close the gap between rural and city schools.
band8Sentence: High-speed broadband can bridge the educational divide between remote villages and metropolitan schools.
explanationVi: 'bridge the divide' là collocation chuẩn cho việc thu hẹp khoảng cách số/giáo dục.

band6Sentence: Art and music should not be cut from school timetables.
band8Sentence: Creative disciplines merit a permanent place within the core secondary curriculum.
explanationVi: Động từ 'merit' (xứng đáng có được) rất tinh tế trong văn nghị luận.

band6Sentence: Punishing criminals harshly does not always stop them from offending again.
band8Sentence: Harsh custodial sentences alone rarely act as an effective deterrent against reoffending.
targetChunk: act as an effective deterrent against
distractors: work like a strong stopper for
explanationVi: 'act as an effective deterrent against' là cụm từ chuyên ngành tội phạm học Band 8.0.

band6Sentence: People are losing touch with local traditions because of global media.
band8Sentence: Globalised media ecosystems risk eroding distinctive local cultural traditions.
targetChunk: risk eroding distinctive local cultural traditions
explanationVi: 'risk + V-ing' + 'erode cultural traditions' tự nhiên và chính xác.

band6Sentence: For example, Amsterdam has built lots of safe bike lanes.
band8Sentence: A compelling illustration is Amsterdam, where dedicated cycling corridors have dramatically lowered car reliance.
explanationVi: 'A compelling illustration is...' thay thế hoàn hảo cho 'For example'.

band6Sentence: Countries like Denmark show that wind power works well.
band8Sentence: Nordic economies such as Denmark exemplify the viability of large-scale wind generation.
explanationVi: Động từ 'exemplify' (là minh chứng điển hình cho) rất gọn và sắc bén.

band6Sentence: This can be seen clearly in how smartphones changed banking.
band8Sentence: This shift is vividly illustrated by the rapid adoption of mobile banking across emerging markets.
explanationVi: 'be vividly illustrated by' giúp đưa dẫn chứng thực tế mượt mà.

band6Sentence: Also, green spaces help people feel less stressed.
band8Sentence: Equally noteworthy is the restorative effect of urban parks on residents' mental health.
explanationVi: Đảo ngữ 'Equally noteworthy is + N' nối ý bổ sung vô cùng trang nhã.

band6Sentence: To sum up, both parents and schools must teach kids online safety.
band8Sentence: In summary, safeguarding young internet users demands a concerted effort from both families and educators.
explanationVi: 'demand a concerted effort from' là cụm chốt giải pháp phối hợp chuẩn Band 8.0.

band6Sentence: In conclusion, I think public transport investment is worth the money.
band8Sentence: On balance, sustained investment in public transit yields far-reaching dividends that clearly justify its fiscal cost.
explanationVi: 'On balance,' kết luận cân nhắc kỹ hai chiều trước khi chốt lập trường.
